description: Compare an hourly or annual starting budget with current US or Canadian postings. Reports opening counts, employer counts, a one-vote-per-employer median when at least five qualify, dated examples and source links. Optionally compare other employers separately. Canadian Job Bank history has a separate month and denominator.

budget.description: Proposed starting amount in the local currency and specified period.

currency.description: Optional currency check. Must match the selected market.

job.description: An occupation code, a job title, or employer/title keywords.

place.description: US or Canada, or a supported state, province or city.

without_employer.description: Exact listed employer name to exclude from the separate peer comparison.

name: compare_hiring_budget
title: Compare a hiring budget with employers’ starting pay
